entities.name: Johor Sultanate
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Johor Sultanate, a political institution in Singapore during Singapura Kingdom and Malay Port (1398–1613). Grew from Parameswara flees Singapura after a Majapahit attack and later founds Malacca and Kingdom of Singapura. Led to the emergence of Obscurity Under the Johor Sultanate.
